note: Reviewed against llm-d-router v1.0.0 and upstream main at 647ca7cacd74de4fcc94b4717b72161de0f683b9 on 2026-11-12. Endpoint caveats are keyed by scorer type; the dashboard does not detect router version or validate producer, metrics, backend cache, predictor health or training. Check the deployed configuration and re-verify after upgrades. Unknown and limited caveats warn but do not suppress winner highlighting.

requirements.missing_reason: Predictor sidecars not found in the EPP pod; training and prediction servers can instead run as services. Verify their configured URLs, readiness, training samples and predictions.

caveats.reason: Verify reachable predictor training and prediction servers, workload-appropriate samples and predictions, and streamingMode. Container presence alone does not prove predictor health. For embeddings, estimate-backed token production handles text; the checked vLLM render backend does not handle this request body.

v0.11.0/v1.0.0 estimate backend cannot process TTS. Main with PR #3712 estimates text input; the vLLM render backend does not. Verify deployed code, predictor samples, predictions and streaming metrics for audio.

Image prompt estimation requires a build with PR #3721 and the estimate backend; output size and inference steps are not estimated. Verify predictor samples and predictions for this non-streaming workload.

PR #3721 adds prompt estimation; PR #4054 adds uploaded-image input estimation on main. Output-generation cost remains outside that estimate. Verify deployed build, producer and predictor samples for edits.
The default passthrough parser on v1.0.0 and checked main extracts no transcription input; PR #3964 is open. Verify the deployed parser, input signal and predictor samples for batch or streaming ASR.

Text embeddings use the estimate backend on checked main, but its pseudo-tokens do not establish actual backend KV-cache reuse; the vLLM render backend does not handle this body. Verify deployed producer, backend cache behavior and scores.
